- [What to eat in loose motions (diarrhoea)](https://drlochab.com/diet-charts/loose-motions/): What to eat and drink in loose motions: ORS after every stool, khichdi, curd rice and banana, foods to avoid, warning signs, a sample day and a food diary.
- [Pancreatitis diet chart: after an attack and long-term](https://drlochab.com/diet-charts/pancreatitis/): Indian diet chart for pancreatitis: small, lower-fat meals after an attack, normal fat with enzymes in chronic pancreatitis, no alcohol and diabetes care.
- [Diet chart for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease](https://drlochab.com/diet-charts/ulcerative-colitis-crohns/): Indian diet chart for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease: low-residue food in a flare or with a Crohn's stricture and a balanced plan in remission.

## Free tools (data stays on the user's device)
- [Your gut health tracker](https://drlochab.com/tools/gut-tracker/): A free, private tracker for bowel movements, stool type, bloating, pain, acidity, food triggers, water, activity, weight and waist.
- [What does your stool say?](https://drlochab.com/tools/stool-check/): Check what your stool's shape and colour mean: constipation, normal, loose motions, black, pale, green, yellow or red stools, and when to see a doctor.
